verdict_detail: Two independent blockers: (1) kernel numeric correctness over non-causal FP4 UNPROVEN (random-fixture NaN; needs real-page numeric test); (2) vLLM backend explicitly refuses non-causal+NVFP4 (guard must be lifted = Option-A work). The kernel entrypoint does NOT hard-reject non-causal (positive signal), but that is not sufficient for A-GO. Recon default holds: stay on Option B; pursue A only after a real-page numeric parity test + guard-lift, on an image rebuilt at the shim-branch HEAD.
